page_description: Short guides for the most common actions in My Many Books.

cta_note.camera_required: Camera required. Best used on mobile.

add_book.caption: Mini tutorial for adding a book.

modify_book.caption: Mini tutorial for editing a book.

delete_book.caption: Mini tutorial for deleting a book.

scanner.caption: Mini tutorial for using the ISBN scanner.

assign_authors_categories.caption: Mini tutorial for assigning authors and categories.

add_authors_categories.caption: Mini tutorial for adding authors and categories.

modify_delete_authors_categories.caption: Mini tutorial for managing authors and categories.

change_password.caption: Mini tutorial for changing your password.

add_book.title: How to add a book
add_book.description: Create a new book entry in your personal library.
add_book.step_3: Fill title, ISBN, and optional details.
add_book.step_4: Save the form to add the book to your library.

modify_book.title: How to modify a book
modify_book.description: Update details of a book that already exists in your library.
modify_book.step_1: Open the book from the list.
modify_book.step_3: Update the fields you need (title, notes, status, etc.).

delete_book.title: How to delete a book
delete_book.description: Remove a book from your library.

scanner.title: How to use the ISBN scanner
scanner.description: Find books quickly by scanning ISBN barcodes.
scanner.step_3: Point the camera to the ISBN barcode.
scanner.step_4: Use the detected ISBN in add or search flow.

assign_authors_categories.title: How to assign authors/categories to a book
assign_authors_categories.description: Link authors and categories while adding or editing a book.
assign_authors_categories.step_1: Open Add book or Edit book form.
assign_authors_categories.step_2: Add one or more authors from the author selector.
assign_authors_categories.step_3: Select categories in the categories list.

add_authors_categories.title: How to add authors/categories
add_authors_categories.description: Create new author and category entries directly from the book form.
add_authors_categories.step_1: Open Add book or Edit book form.
add_authors_categories.step_2: Use the Add icon near Authors or Categories.
add_authors_categories.step_3: Fill the dialog fields and confirm creation.
add_authors_categories.step_4: Verify the new entry is available in the selectors.

modify_delete_authors_categories.title: How to modify/delete authors/categories
modify_delete_authors_categories.description: Manage existing author and category entries from dedicated dialogs.
modify_delete_authors_categories.step_1: Open Add book or Edit book form.
modify_delete_authors_categories.step_2: Use the Manage icon near Authors or Categories.
modify_delete_authors_categories.step_3: Edit fields and save, or choose delete.

change_password.title: How to change the password
change_password.description: Update your account password in security settings (when available).
